future.title: Will과 be going to
future.when: 미래에 대해 말할 때, 즉 지금 내린 결정·예측·계획을 말할 때 씁니다.
future.body: 말하는 순간 내린 결정(I'll get it!), 약속·제안·일반적인 예측에는 will을 씁니다(I think it will rain). 미리 세운 계획에는 be going to를 쓰고(I'm going to study abroad), 지금 보이는 근거에 따른 예측에도 씁니다(Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.).
examples: I'm hungry. — I'll make you a sandwich.
We're going to visit Japan next month.
Look at the sky! It's going to rain.
mistakes: I will to call you. → I will call you. — will 뒤에는 to 없이 동사 원형을 씁니다.
She going to buy a car. → She is going to buy a car. — going to 앞에는 동사 be가 필요합니다: she is going to.

past_continuous.title: 과거 진행형 (Past continuous)
past_continuous.when: 과거의 특정 시점에 진행 중이었거나, 다른 일에 의해 중단되었거나, 다른 행동과 동시에 일어난 행동을 말할 때 씁니다.
past_continuous.body: was 또는 were와 동사-ing를 씁니다. 진행 중인 행동에는 과거 진행형을, 이를 중단한 행동에는 보통 과거 시제를 씁니다: I was driving when the phone rang. 두 행동이 동시에 일어났을 때는 while을 씁니다.
examples: I was cooking dinner at eight yesterday.
They were watching a film when the lights went out.
While I was walking home, it started to rain.
mistakes: She was drive to work when it started raining. → She was driving to work when it started raining. — 어제 특정 시점에 진행 중인 행동이므로 was driving을 씁니다.
We were wait for the bus at seven. → We were waiting for the bus at seven. — were 뒤에는 -ing형 waiting을 씁니다.

must_should.title: Must / Should / Have to
must_should.when: 의무, 조언, 금지된 일을 말할 때 씁니다.
must_should.body: Should는 조언을 나타냅니다. Must는 화자의 강한 의무나 규칙을 나타냅니다. Have to는 직장이나 법처럼 외부에서 생긴 의무를 나타냅니다. 부정형에 주의하세요: mustn't는 금지라는 뜻이고, don't have to는 필요하지 않다는 뜻입니다. must와 should 뒤에는 동사 원형을 씁니다.
examples: You don't have to come if you're busy.
mistakes: You must to wear a helmet. → You must wear a helmet. — must 뒤에는 to 없이 바로 동사 원형이 옵니다.
She have to work on Saturday. → She has to work on Saturday. — she와 함께 쓰면 have to가 has to로 바뀝니다.
